description: A Magic card's identity (mana cost, type, color identity, legalities, image) and what ArcaneMetriX reads in it: its role in a deck and its tags. Takes a card name or a Scryfall oracle id; a name that matches nothing exactly returns close matches to choose from.

card.description: A card name (`Sol Ring`) or oracle id.
